adjudication.rationale: The diff adds standalone assets `app/assets/stylesheets/embed.css.scss` and `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`. The new layout `app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb` calls `stylesheet_link_tag 'embed'`, but the diff does not show `embed.css` being pulled in via an existing manifest (e.g. `application.css`) or being added to an assets precompile list. Under typical Rails 4 production settings (`config.assets.compile = false`), referencing a non-precompiled asset via `stylesheet_link_tag` can raise `AssetNotPrecompiledError` (500). Similarly, `embed.js` is introduced but not referenced anywhere in the app and is not shown being precompiled or exposed for external consumers.
